meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系

copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会调用arboreto从基因表达数据推断转录因子调控靶基因的关系,返回TF、靶基因和重要性分数;还能用Dask在本地多核或集群上并行计算。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析RNA-seq等转录组数据、找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系或构建调控网络时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses arboreto to infer which transcription factors regulate which target genes from gene expression data, returning TF, target and importance scores; supports Dask-based parallel computation on local cores or clusters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze transcriptomics data such as RNA-seq to find TF-target relationships or build regulatory networks.

say_en.text: Infer the regulatory network from this gene expression matrix.
say_en.note: Runs GRNBoost2; outputs a TF-target-importance table.

say_en.text: Run GENIE3 on the same data and compare the two results.
Use only these transcription factors and limit the output to top 5000 edges.
